title: BGP Usage for Software-Defined WAN (SD-WAN) Overlay Networks
abstract: This document illustrates how a BGP-based control plane can be used to manage large-scale Software-Defined WAN (SD-WAN) overlay networks by distributing edge service reachability information, WAN port attributes, and underlay path details, thereby minimizing manual provisioning. In such deployments, BGP can provide a standards-based mechanism for distributing information that may otherwise be exchanged using proprietary SD-WAN control plane mechanisms. However, extensions to BGP are needed to achieve this.
